resolved_intents.intent: Perform valid login with username and password
Search for product and add to cart

missing_methods.intent: Verify user profile name is visible in dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the dashboard header to load. Locate the user profile name element in the header. Verify that the element is visible and displayed. Optionally validate that the displayed name matches the expected_name parameter. Return True if visible, False otherwise or raise an assertion error.
